objs.name: document
objs.description: Central artifact in policies, guidelines and documents management; participates in creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving workflows.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document; selected when creating a new object.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: References to other documents or external references.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Associated IT applications as master data.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Companies relevant to the document's scope or validity.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational areas where the document is valid.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Document attachment that is linked to a document; can be released together with the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information attached to a document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Equipment or equipment-related information attached to a document; subject to its own versioning.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New document created in the system.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Document content or properties modified; may create new version.

evts.name: attach_object_to_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object to a document (Attachment, Additional_info or Equippment).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Document passes through the release workflow and becomes visible to readers; attachments may be released with the main document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Document and its attachments may be archived for defined period; archiving is not physical deletion.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Invalidated document reactivated; a new version is created.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribution of documents to the distribution list (e-mail or info-based).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Language-dependent display of released documents; translation has its own release workflow.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Check for validity extension and potential new version creation.

evts.name: override_aks
evts.description: Override process for invalidation of documents.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees can create Change Proposals for documents; change proposals are managed in the cockpit.

evts.name: review_change_proposal
evts.description: Review of Change Proposals during the lifecycle; may impact release.

evts.name: apply_change_proposal
evts.description: Applying approved Change Proposals creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: create_translation
evts.description: Process to translate released documents (already covered by Translate Document).

o2e.description: Creating a document affects the Document
Editing a document affects the Document
Attaching an object to Document affects Attachments
Attaching an object to Document affects Additional_info
Attaching an object to Document affects Equippment
Releasing a document affects the Document
Releasing a document also releases Attachments
Archiving a document affects the Document
Reactivating a document affects the Document
Distributing a document affects the Document
Change Proposal is associated with the Document
Review of Change Proposals affects the Document
Applying a Change Proposal creates a new version of the Document
